description: Detects supply chain disruptions via anomaly ensemble, retrieves recovery playbooks from Pinecone, and generates reasoning chains via DeepSeek-R1 on Ollama

capabilities.name: detect_disruption
capabilities.description: Run anomaly ensemble on supply chain signals and produce disruption alert with playbook

methods.name: proposal
methods.description: Generate disruption assessment proposal for Orchestrator consensus

methods.name: debate_respond
methods.description: Revise disruption assessment based on other agents' proposals

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Execute approved disruption response and publish alert + playbook to Kafka

kafka_topics.topology_note: Ingress is HTTP-A2A (POST /a2a). Kafka is publish-only here (ADR-038). 'consumes_planned' is design intent and NOT subscribed today — see scripts/audit/topic_consumer_truth.py.
